headline: Personal Trainer

experience.title: Personal Trainer
bullets: Train about 25 regular clients a week, from teenagers to adults in their sixties.
Assess each client's strength, flexibility and health limits before writing a program.
Run small-group classes in circuit training and mobility, and coach on nutrition habits.
Keep the gym's first aid kit and emergency plan up to date and hold a current CPR certificate.

experience.title: Fitness Instructor
bullets: Led evening Zumba and circuit classes for 20 to 40 participants.
Welcomed new members and explained memberships and class schedules.

summary: Personal trainer with four years coaching adults of all ages in Abra. I assess each client's fitness and health limits, design training and lifestyle programs, and keep them motivated through personal attention. I also run group classes and handle client relations for the gym.
skills: Basic Life Support and first aid
